tagline: A 2D physics toy box. The pile lives in the GIF; one invite is the same room.
description:
Close it, keep the GIF, and the stack is still there. Send the invite and a friend drops boxes in the same room — no account, no install, works on a plane.

Grab anything and throw it. Tap to drop boxes, balls, or a ragdoll. Pull the slingshot at a pyramid. Slide gravity from moon-light through reverse. Reset for a fresh pile.

The Matter.js demos are a page you visit. This one is a file you keep, and a room you share.
